cases.description: MCP stdio JSON-RPC exposes strictly 2 tools (aice_read, aice_splice) and enforces binary/firewall parity

tools.name: aice_read
tools.description: Read files, dirs, symbols, :L, search, or file list. MULTI-FILE STREAM ENGINE: NEVER call this tool multiple times in a file-by-file loop! Batch in path or paths.

path.description: File/dir, f:sym, f:L1-L50, or space-separated list

tools.name: aice_splice
tools.description: Create, overwrite, or splice files/symbols/:L/hunks (aice_write). MULTI-FILE STREAM ENGINE: NEVER call this tool multiple times in a file-by-file loop! Use === file:sym === in code.

code.description: Code, multi-line hunk, or === file:sym === stream

requiredInvariants: aice_splice updates App.reset and rejects invalid App.inc with isError:true
rustParityContract.deltaNote: Rust closes B-S3 by removing hidden legacy MCP aliases (aice_context, aice_create, etc.) from executeToolCall as well.

cases.description: MCP tools/call rejects aice_read and aice_splice when enabled:false in aice.config.json

content.text: AICE is disabled for this project via aice.config.json ("enabled": false). Use native tools or run 'aice enable'.

requiredInvariants: Both aice_read and aice_splice return isError:true mentioning enabled:false
